draft: The heating company that shows up at the fall fest is the one you want showing up at your house.
Mossy boulders doing water conservation work. Pretty and practical is the dream combo.
A yard that feeds the ecosystem instead of just the ego. Love this approach.
Plumbers taking the weekend off is the real holiday miracle. Enjoy it, folks.
First furnace firing of fall always smells like the house is cooking dust. Glad its normal.
The filter you forgot about all summer is the one doing all the work. Fair point.
Weekends are for the yard, not fighting the yard. Western CO finally getting landscapers who get it.
Two new apprentices, zero plumbing experience. Congrats to the whole Goldberg crew.
Leaks never schedule themselves conveniently. Good to know the cavalry is local.
Being proactive about the furnace beats meeting it on a first name basis in January.
The one oak that survived the May frost like it was nothing. Certified arborist flex.
Sephora for men is the most accurate plumbing aisle description I have ever read.
Descaling a tankless is the spa day your water heater deserves. Mineral buildup is real.
Fence posts you set yourself just hit different. Solid work start to finish.
